name: ghostlap
description: Ghostlap for Godot 4: Claude playtests your game (plays real levels frame by frame from the shell, rules pass / fail / blocked with checked evidence, replays the run and renders a captioned video), plus a game-feel toolkit (jump arcs, coyote time, acceleration, dashes, hitstop... with verified, file:line-linked fixes). Needs the ghostlap CLI and Godot 4.3+.
